frames.narration: All current-word errors contribute. Feedback goes from the head through decoder states, across the source-note handoff, and through encoder reads to their learned weights.

frames.title: Backward prepares feedback; weights are still unchanged
frames.narration: Both encoder and decoder receive measured weight gradients. The word table and head do too. Backward has not edited any stored prediction or parameter yet.
